Telephone Manager Initialization Functions

Configuring a Telephone Tool Through a Scripting Language

This section describes the functions you can use to configure a telephone tool through a scripting language. It describes the TELGetConfig function that you use to access the configuration details for a telephone tool. It also describes the TELSetConfig function that places the configuration information into the configuration field in the telephone record associated with the telephone tool.
